products.name: 2026 Unbranded
products.description_html:
Unbranded is a new blend of small batch shou Puer teas from white2tea, including a substantial amount of medium and light ferment shou, as well as aged shou material.

The character of this tea is varied and layered on a budget. An initial burst of medium dark chocolate followed by a red berry huigan [returning sweetness] in the mouth. The lighter ferment brightness shows up in later steeps as the heavier shou thickness wanes. Unbranded is a great way to stock your shou coffers for the winter.

Pressed in 2026. 200g cakes, with 5 cakes in a bamboo tong.

products.name: 2026 EZST Minis
products.description_html:
Attention tea club members, we will be including one box of this tea in your November tea club!

Our Easy Street (EZ ST) minis are a blend of our small batch ripe Puer tea.

Easy Street is just like it sounds. Easy. Affordable. Convenient.

Glide through your morning with classic shou that we blended to be bomb-proof and neglect-able. Don't know how to brew Puer tea?* No problem. Do whatever you want. It'll work out just fine. Convenient for travel, office, daily mug neglect, you name it. Smooth, thick and enjoyable shou Puer tea on the cheap.

You can also thrust a box of these upon new acquaintances as a gift, sealing your fate forever as a delightfully weird tea person. We know from experience. 

Each purchase is for one box which contains a ~49g stack (7 X  7g minis).

*One little caveat, if you are totally new to shou Puer tea, this tea was pressed in 2026, so it will be a bit fresh and have some flavors you may not be used to. It will improved greatly within the first couple of years, as most shou Puer teas do.

products.name: 2026 Kleptomania
products.description_html:
Kleptomania is a new blend of small batch shou Puer teas we have made over the last couple of years. Made with a bunch of teas that very few people process into shou Puer. 

Pushing on the boundaries of classic Menghai area character by using quality materials that are often sent to raw Puer production, rather than being used in shou. The culmination of batches spanning a couple of years and not an easy blend to remake. Incredible thickness and complexity. Strong and engaging throughout. Worthy of focused gongfu.

Pressed in 2026. 200g cakes, with 5 cakes in a bamboo tong.

products.name: 2026 Loon-Call in the Dark
products.description_html:
A blend of several ambitious small batch shou Puer productions fermented in conjunction with several different shou Puer producers, the results are a full bodied tea akin to a shou Puer version of sweet steamed milk, soothing and rich with inviting texture and layered flavor. 

The original Loon-call in the Dark production from 2022 is, to this day, one of our favorite small batch shou blends. We recommend you buy the aged version while it's still around.

The Loon-Call in the Dark cake was pressed in 2026. 200g cakes, with 5 cakes in a bamboo tong.

An excellent everyday ripe Puer tea, with a soft sweetness and a smooth warming body. A well balanced ripe Puer tea for beginners or veteran drinkers alike.

We broke the dang mold on this one, our first circular waffle pattern ever. We plan to return to our regularly scheduled line pattern waffle in the future.

products.name: Moon Bloom Dancong
products.description_html:
From the Guangdong province of China, our Moon Bloom Dancong oolong tea made from yelaixiang varietal.

The varietal name Yelaixiang roughly translates as "fragrance that arrives in the night". Though the varietal does not share the same notoriety as Milan due to its much smaller production size, the lack of fame shouldn't deter you from trying it. Our Moon Bloom is heavily oxidized and has a smooth, reddish liquor. The flavors are fruity and floral, with heavy fragrances throughout.


Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: Black Ant Dancong
products.description_html:
Our first time selling this type of Dancong, Black Ant or hei may. Like most dancongs, it has a few stories behind the name. Some say it is because the twisted leaves look like black ants. Others because ants congregated on the trees. In any case, it's a subset of zhilanxiang varietal that isn't as broadly famous and is a bit underappreciated.

The tea has a powerful burst of perfume. Sweet, sticky sap body and funky florals. Caramelized citrus fruits and honey. It's over the top, even for a dancong. If you love to nose around an oolong session, you'll want the black ant. 

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: Nine Lives Yellow
products.description_html:
Nine Lives Yellow is a yellow tea (also called huangcha in Mandarin Chinese) from Sichuan province.

Made from a purple bud varietal of tea that is usually processed into green tea, our Nine Lives Yellow was made with an extra step of huangmen that envelopes the tea and allows for a hot oxidation that yellows the tea to a golden hue.

The profile drinks with a smoother body than green tea and a sappy sweetness. The fragrances are bright and summery with a sticky quality that evokes malted grains and a slight touch of earth.

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

products.name: Black Hills Gold
products.description_html:
Black Hills Gold is a yellow tea (also called huangcha in Mandarin Chinese) from Sichuan province.

We hate to even use the descriptor given how overused it is in the broader market, but this is from tea that is forest grown; meaning the tea is spares, natural growing and interspersed with wild growth forest. It's a small production tea with a special character. Take some quiet time with it and it will reward you for it with a soothing sweetness and bright engaging session. 

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

The earliest version of this tea was called Huang NS, featured a few seasons ago in our white2tea monthly club. This is our most recent version, with a longer huangmen (enveloping oxidation) process.

products.description_html:
Slow Roll is a white tea from Sichuan province.

From a pristine natural environment, the soothing clarity of this tea is a rare find. Cotton candy sweetness with soft and supple aromatics that shift in early steeps atop a sugarcane soup. A beautiful tea that might not be the most direct introduction for beginners, but that veteran tea drinkers will likely appreciate for its elegance.

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

products.name: Owl Orchard Red
products.description_html:
Our Owl Orchard Red is a black tea from Fujian province.

If you imagine yourself getting into a knock-down, drag-out fight in the middle of a fruit market - this tea is something like that in leaf form. One of those black teas that the vast majority of people will like. Who hates fruit? Not us. 

We will try to squeeze this into the tea club before the end of 2026.


Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

Owl Orchard Red just sounded better to us than Owl Orchard Black - in Mandarin Chinese the name for black tea is hongcha which directly translates as red tea. We annoyingly use them interchangeably for no reason. Just making sure you all have language lessons while you shop for tea.

products.name: Siesta Loose Leaf Decaf Shou Puer
products.description_html:
The loose leaf version of our new Decaf tea experiments. We commissioned this tea to be decaffeinated using the CO2 process to lower the caffeine to the EU standard. This does not mean that the tea is caffeine free, but it does mean that it only has around 0.4% of the original caffeine content. (Unless you are super sensitive to caffeine, it's barely noticeable) This process does change the overall flavor and aroma, but they're excellent for most people who need a night time drinking option. 

The tea you probably didn't realize you needed: a decaffeinated small batch shou Puer. Our Decaf 2026 Siesta Shou Puer is a thick bodied, smooth and soothing nightcap. We've been drinking it regularly after late night meals and can't get enough of it.

Each purchase is for 50g or 250g of loose leaf tea in a resealable pouch.

products.name: 2026 Dark Peony
products.description_html:
The return of our sold out oddball white2tea processing adventure. Our 2026 Dark Peony is a Yunnan tea produced at our behest with a sort of combination between Fujian white tea style processing with the addition of oxidation that mimics an aged white or black tea.

Dark Peony has a complex aromatic profile that lilts between the brighter tones of a fresh white tea and the deeper ripe stone fruits of a black tea. The soup's character is somewhere in between sharp and soft, with a playful little dancing between personalities that make it both engaging and difficult to pin down.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2026.

*For categorical boxes, Dark Peony doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

products.name: 2026 Lodestar
products.description_html:
2026 Lodestar is a sun-dried white tea commissioned by white2tea in spring 2026 to be made from Yunnan dayezhong [large leaf varietal] that is typically made into raw Puer tea. 

This sun drying has given this tea a varied oxidation and a natural feel that drags it a little out of the white tea category and into a smoother territory than most. The brighter aromatics drift into pears and cotton candy. When pushed the body becomes red and creamy with stone fruits. An excellent daily drinker that is as versatile as it is easy to enjoy.

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2026 Spring Raw Liubao
products.description_html:
Liubao heicha, also known as dark tea, a post fermented tea from Guangxi province in China.

This tea was made on commission for white2tea in early spring of 2026.

Not the typical mass produced and pile fermented dark liubao. Raw may be a misnomer, but calling it green doesn’t quite seem right either, and some folk have even suggested this tea qualify as a yellow tea or some hybrid unfermented heicha. In China people often call it nongjia or farmer style, though it is rarely sold on the open market due to small production sizes and lack of proper accreditation. You will find similarities in this tea that spans genres – green tea, yellow tea, heicha, raw Puer – there is a reason you can’t pin it down easily. 

Bright aromas and sweetness with a hefty huigan (returning sweetness) that is sticky and refreshing. Lovely to drink now or age as you desire.

Each sample purchase is for 25g of loose tea. Each basket contains ~250g of tea.

products.name: 2026 Irish Supper
products.description_html:
One of our new Decaf tea experiments. We commissioned this tea to be decaffeinated using the CO2 process to lower the caffeine to the EU standard. This does not mean that the tea is caffeine free, but it does mean that it only has around 0.4% of the original caffeine content. (Unless you are super sensitive to caffeine, it's barely noticeable) This process does change the overall flavor and aroma, but they're excellent for most people who need a night time drinking option. 

Our 2026 Irish Supper is a Yunnan sun-dried black tea commission made especially for white2tea from material that is usually destined for raw Puer production. We then sent it to be decaffeinated and be an all-star of our decaf lineup.

Irish Supper is malty and thick bodied black tea with a classic Yunnan profile of sweet grains and stone fruit. Brew it strong and enjoy it with a midnight snack without fear of disrupting your dreamy sleep.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

Have you ever wanted just one more session of raw Puer tea, but you also have to work in the morning? This is the scenario our Decaf raw Puer was built to address. The intensity of raw Puer tea, without the sleep wrecking power. This is it's own 2024 blend, but most similar to 2024 Everybody Works But Father. The processing changes the color of the tea, but it's still relatively young raw Puer. 

The characteristic base of raw Puer is still present. Deep sweetness and long lingering huigan (returning sweetness in the mouth), along with a plesant bitterness and complex depth. Any degenerate tea lover would be happy to drink this at 1 in the morning. 

Each purchase is for 200g of tea. For tong orders, there are 5 cakes per bamboo tong. Samples are shipped in resealable bags of 25g each.

products.name: 2026 Blood Moon
products.description_html:
The return of the Blood Moon. A bit of an odd hybrid Yunnan tea. Picked and processed most similarly to yueguangbai or moonlight white tea that has been shade dried, this tea was also intentionally partially oxidized, about half way to being a black tea*. It's a unique tea that feels closer to an aged shade dried white.

The bright and clear soup is sweet and enduring, with a velvety softness and aromas that flit between vegetal and fruity. Soft strawberry flavors and grassy honey are at the forefront of its youth, though we suspect it will deepen and thicken up in the coming years. It's a beautiful experiment to experience.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2026.

*For categorical boxes, Blood Moon doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

products.name: Half Dream Matcha
products.description_html:
Our Half Dream Matcha is a Chinese matcha made from material from Zhejiang province and the longjing (dragon well) 43 cultivar. 

A creamy and dreamy matcha for those who enjoy a subtle and nuanced matcha experience. A strong mineral backbone expresses the cultivar's signature character alongside an elegant umami. We prefer this one its own, though if you want to make decadent lattes we won't tell anybody.

Each purchase is for a 30g tin of matcha.

products.name: 2026 Manichee
products.description_html:
Our 2026 Manichee is a stepped up version of a blend we made for the first time nearly a decade ago. It has a distinct Yiwu character, soft and sweet with a calming, thick soup and direct sweetness. This tea is great to drink right away or age for the long term. Our 2017 Manichee production is in a beautiful place after nearly a decade of aging in our storage in Guangzhou. 

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

[returning sweetness in the mouth and throat] This tea has a juicy sweetness alongside it's vibrant, youthful characteristics. Excellent daily drinker with plenty of layered drama to tease out in a gongfu session.

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2026 Janiform
products.description_html:
Our 2026 Janiform is a blend of material that we've aged in our Menghai storage prior to pressing. The soup has a feeling of rich salinity that leaves a wake of sweetness. The last vestiges of freshness float above the aromatics with a turn into honey huigan. Highly recommend trying it sooner rather than later, since this blend would be difficult to recreate.

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: Milan Red
products.description_html:
A return of our sold out black tea was made with Milan (honey orchid) varietal from Guangdong province that is usually slated to be made into Milan Dancong oolong.

The Milan Red is a black tea with an intense aromatic range from the steeped leaf to the cup. Long lingering fragrances and sweetness are hallmarks of this unique tea that bridges the gap between oolong lovers and black tea aficionados.

Each purchase is for 25 grams.


Black tea from Guangdong province.

products.name: Almond Red
products.description_html:
This black tea was made with Taorenxiang (peach pit fragrance) varietal and is technically a sub-type of xingrenxiang which translates as almond fragrance, but we're calling it almond anyhow because it's the more recognizable umbrella group.  This tea is usually destined for Dancong oolong production, but we commissioned a black tea production from this spring.

The Almond Red is a black tea with a broad fragrance profile that incorporates the base of toasted marzipan sweetness, through vanilla and overripe red stone fruits. A stellar tea for aromatic black tea lovers.

Each purchase is for 25 grams.


Black tea from Guangdong province.

products.name: Daily Jinjunmei
products.description_html:
The long awaited return of one of our most popular black teas.

Our Daily Jinjunmei is made from Meizhan varietal tea from Fujian province.

A black tea that gets the damn job done. Delicious and layered flavors that transcend the affordable price, coupled with skillfully produced aromatics typical of high quality Chinese black teas. If you are looking for a daily black tea for gongfu tea, British style tea brewing or even in a thermos on the go, you won't find a better black tea in this price tier.

Available in quantities of 50g and 250g.

products.name: 2026 Almond Dancong Maocha
products.description_html:
A higher-end variation on our Milan Maocha brick. Maocha is a bit of a misnomer, how can a tea be both maocha [loose tea] and a brick? In this case, the term maocha refers to the Dancong oolong tea being left in its raw form before pressing. We commissioned this production to be left with stems and large leaves for this pressing.

The brick has a strong almond aroma with marzipan sweetness behind the roast. A delectable treat for oolong lovers.

Our Dancong oolong tea bricks are a little tricky to brew. Very punchy when pushed, we recommend dropping your leaf down a couple of grams and doing flash steeps gongfu style. The tea can often be heavily fragmented when broken off of the brick, which means the surface area is multiplied and the tea steeps fast and strong. For example, we usually brew 6 grams of raw Puer in a 100ml gaiwan, but for this tea we drop down to around 4 grams for a more even session.

Each brick is 200 grams. This is a 2024 Dancong, pressed in early 2025.

products.name: 2026 Slow Burn
products.description_html:
A blend of small batch shou Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

Smoke clouds in the forest. Inky sweetness when leaned on, the pine fire aromatics stick within the velvety soup. An excellent companion to whisky or a cigar.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2026 Waxcap
products.description_html:
A blend of several small batch ripe Puer teas fermented using our own material and under our own supervision spanning several years, Waxcap was then sent to Fujian province to be charcoal roasted by hand by veteran Wuyi Yancha makers in 2025 and pressed in early 2026 in Yunnan after a period of rest.

Coffee lovers will find commonalities with the combination of the fermented character and the flame from the roast. Smooth character and a candied nut sweetness lingers underneath veil of charcoal. 

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2026 Sledgehammer
products.description_html:
A blend of Yunnan raw Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

A great fit for cigar lovers and Scotch whisky fanatics who want tea in the morning, but this tea is a surprise that will likely garner even fans who are wary of smoke as well.

Burly character and balanced bitterness with a strong Menghai presence and strong huigan. Intense when pushed, this is a heavy hitter on a budget.

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

For aging, we recommend that smoked teas be sealed and separated from other teas, as the fresh smoke will pass along to the teas next to it. Or you can keep them with your cigars.

products.name: 2026 Terry
products.description_html:
Old arbor sun dried white tea from Yunnan sent to Fujian province in 2025 to be hand charcoal roasted in the Wuyi mountains by veteran yancha oolong makers. The Terry blend was rested until early 2026 when it was pressed.

Fragrances and flavor depth rarely present in white tea. Easy to veer off into long descriptors, stuff like almond butter on crispy toast with blackberry jam sweetness came up last session. It's the kind of tea that will yield different experiences with different ratios and water temps and keep you coming back for more because of its distinctive intrigue. 

Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.description_html:
Laochatou are a condensed nugget of tea that naturally fuses together during the shou Puer pile process. These are from several of our small batches ranging from 2021-2024.

We blended together several batches of laochatou from our shou productions and then sent to Tongmuguan in Fujian to be pine smoked like Lapsang. A real unique combination of campfire smoke and the smooth, woody profile of shou. Excellent endurance and a versatile brewing companion with one-of-a-kind character.

Available in 50g and 250g bags of loose laochatou.

A word of fair warning, normally shou Puer can be sorted out using machines to remove most unwanted bits like hair, stray threads and the like, but with chatou the tea is fused together. So, if you are faint of heart and scared of a few stray bits here and there, skip this tea and go for a pressed cake like Lumber Slut. If you're not afraid of some white spots and surprises, this is a rewarding pile of nuggets. No need to break them apart, just hit them with a boiling rinse and you're off to the races.

products.name: 2026 Swerve
products.description_html:
Sun dried old arbor assamica varietal from Yunnan province that is typically made into raw Puer tea. We commissioned this production in 2025, sent it to Wuyi in Fujian to be hand charcoal roasted by veteran yancha makers. Pressed in Yunnan in early 2026.

Swerve is vibrantly aromatic and syrupy sweet. Spiced plums, toasted cinnamon and mulled wine tannins. Enough intrigue to entrance veteran oolong and black tea drinkers, coupled with heroic endurance. Spectacular tea.

Pressed in 2026. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2026 Lapsun
products.description_html:
The return of our sold out, cross province experiment.

Sun dried bud heavy picking of assamica varietal from Yunnan province that is typically made into Puer. We commissioned this black tea production in 2025 and sent it to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse. Pressed in Yunnan in early 2026.

All of the thick body and malty sweetness of a chocolatey Yunnan black tea, laced with the thick pine smoke of a Lapsang. Better than drinking scotch at 9 in the morning.


Each cakes is 200g with 5 cakes per 1 kg tong.

products.name: Orchid Heart
products.description_html:
Our Orchid Heart is an oolong from the Fujian province of China.

The name of this oolong is a direct translation from the Su Xin Lan varietal, which is not commonly sold in the West and not very popular in China either. Sometimes fame isn't everything. This varietal has a unique mixture of aromas and flavors that varies from pine needles, to the herbaceous and floral.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: No.2 Rougui
products.description_html:
Rougui is an oolong tea from the Fujian province of China.

The name rougui literally translates as cinnamon, one of the most famous varieties of yancha [rock oolong]. From early May 2018, this tea had four roasts, but the flavors of the flame have receded by the time of its release to reveal the flavors and aromas of dark fruits and deep mineral character within the tea. Rather than give a play-by-play of the complexities that occur in this tea over the course of a gongfu session, we recommend trying this tea and experiencing it for yourself. One of our favorite yanchas.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: Dahongpao
products.description_html:
Our Dahongpao is a blend of oolong tea from the Fujian province of China.

Originally used to describe the tea from a small group of bushes in Fujian, the name Dahongpao in a modern context is more commonly used to describe blends of yancha [rock oolong] instead of denoting a varietal or processing distinction. Our Dahongpao is a blend that relies heavily on the Meizhan varietal with traditional style processing that incorporates the roast, mineral nature and fragrances of typical yancha in a balanced way. Excellent as an introduction to quality yancha.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

Iron Arhat is an Wuyi yancha oolong tea from the Fujian province of China.

The name tieluohan literally translates as Iron Arhat, one of the more famous varieties of yancha (rock oolong). This is a medium-heavy three roast tea with deeper inner florality that rests beneath the cooling, minty character that lies under the fire. This tea has excellent endurance and can be re-steeped many times.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: 2022 Airtanker
products.description_html:
In 2022 we pressed a series of small batch shou Puer blends that incorporated experimental lighter ferment styles of shou Puer with the intent to age them before release. These teas are now being released in 2026 after ~4 year of aging in our Guangzhou storage. They are still developing, but drinkable straight away. This will not be a traditional shou Puer experience, as they incorporate more character, nuance and raw Puer characteristic than most shou Puer. 

2022 Airtanker is more of a classic shou with some light ferment shine on it. Menghai character and thickness, with rich and heavy soup and balanced bitterness. Dark chocolate and berry sweetness riding the undercurrent.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea. Pressed in 2022, Released in 2026.

2022 Fleet operates somewhere in between raw and ripe, with a significant amount of very light ferment material that showcases the original raw characteristics. Stone fruit and berry tarts, pastries dusted with cocoa powder. The long lingering huigan (returning sweetness) is a rare feature of this shou. products.name: Dulcimer White
products.description_html:
Dulcimer White is a small production of a heritage varietal often called cai cha (or more recently gongmei*) from Fujian province. 

The aromatics on this tea pop right off the leaf, with a mix of bright vegetal notes and a peppery lift. The soup has a thick and creamy minerality when pushed, or can be floral and soft when brewed gently. This older style of tea has fallen out of favor in Fujian in recent years, but it has a distinct charm all its own. 

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

*Gongmei is a term of a little confusion, as for many years it was used to describe a grade of tea, but now the name gongmei is supposed to only refer to this varietal

products.name: 2025 Raw Autumn Liubao
products.description_html:
Liubao heicha, also known as dark tea, a post fermented tea from Guangxi province in China.

This tea was made on commission for white2tea in early autumn of 2025.

Not the typical mass produced and pile fermented dark liubao. Raw may be a misnomer, but calling it green doesn’t quite seem right either, and some folk have even suggested this tea qualify as a yellow tea or some hybrid unfermented heicha. In China people often call it nongjia or farmer style, though it is rarely sold on the open market due to small production sizes and lack of proper accreditation. You will find similarities in this tea that spans genres – green tea, yellow tea, heicha, raw Puer – there is a reason you can’t pin it down easily. 

Lively aromas with a sticky sweetness and refreshing taste. Lovely to drink now or age as you desire.

Each basket contains ~250g of tea inside of a paper bag.

products.name: Canton Canon
products.description_html:
A staple in Guangdong province tea culture, this Tieguanyin from Fujian was hand charcoal roasted in Chaozhou, Guangdong. It's an older style of tea roasting that has fallen out of favor in the broader market, but has fans (often among the older folk) in places like Guangzhou and Hong Kong to this day.

The charcoal roast is very heavy, riding the thin line between scorched and gorgeous. The base aspects of the the oolong peek through the flame and will continue to brighten up as this tea's roasted character settles in. The soothing fired profile is a favorite in our teacups during the cold autumn and winter months, but it's also a refreshing cold brew in the summer.


Each purchase is for 25 grams.

products.name: Almond Dancong
products.description_html:
From the Guangdong province of China, our Almond Dancong oolong is made from a taorenxiang varietals.

Taorenxiang (peach pit fragrance) is technically a sub-type of xingrenxiang which translates as almond fragrance, but we're calling it almond anyhow because it's the more recognizable umbrella group.

The tea tastes of creamy divinity (the southern dessert, not an act of divine intervention), stone fruits and marzipan with a bright an uplifting roasted aromatic profile.


Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.description_html:
From the Guangdong province of China, our Full House Dancong oolong tea is made from jianghuaxiang varietal.

The name jianghuaxiang translates literally as "ginger flower fragrance". The floral and subtly spiced aromas and flavors are elegantly balanced into a soothing, sweet and enduring dancong. Our first time offering this lesser known style.


Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: Heaven Dancong
products.description_html:
Translated from the name tong tian xiang in Chinese, which refers to a fragrance so strong that it can reach to the heavens. Can't argue with lofty aspirations, right?

Tong tian xiang is thought to be a naturally occurring cross between well-known shui xian varietals in Fenghuang.

Our Heaven Dancong has pure flower fragrances that leap from the leaves. The aromas didn't reach the heavens in our trials, though they did fill the room. Long lasting huigan (returning sweetness in the mouth) and a powerful bouquet of sweet flavors and floral scents.

Each purchase is for 25 grams.

products.description_html:
Our Barranca tieguanyin oolong from Fujian province.

This is a traditional style of Tieguanyin with a medium roast. The soup is sticky and rich with herbaceous aromas that border on the cannabinoid. Complex character that evolves from steep to steep between the rinsed leaf, empty cup and in the mouth and throat. An attentive gongfu session is a must for this tea. 

Each purchase is for roughly 7 grams of tea.

products.name: Red Stiletto
products.description_html:
Our Red Stiletto bud heavy black tea from Sichuan province.

A commission from 2025 spring, our Red Stiletto is a unique black tea made from Sichuan cultivars that are usually destined for green tea production.

Cotton candy sweetness and a silky smooth soup. This tea has a natural comfort to it that is better experienced than explained. If you're searching for teas that scream at you with flavor and aroma, look elsewhere. This tea is a whisper on the wind. 

Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

products.name: Gold Flower Jinjunmei
products.description_html:
Our Gold Flower Jinjunmei from Fujian province.

A sweet bouquet of a jinjunmei. Baked yam sweetness with a chrysanthemum aroma that flits between herbaceous, floral and mint.  The delicate buds offer a soft and layered experience.


Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

products.name: Old Forest Jinjunmei
products.description_html:
Our Old Forest Jinjunmei from Fujian province.

A higher-end version of jinjunmei made from a lovely garden that we've come to adore. Creamy and rich with aromatics that flow between wood shavings and incense. This tea is velvety sweet and subtle with a nurturing feel that demands attention.


Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

products.name: Yes Fat Cat Teacup
products.description_html:
The Yes Fat Cat teacup was designed and commissioned by white2tea.

Each piece is Jingdezhen porcelain, handmade and hand painted for white2tea. The pictures accurately represent the overall design of the teacup, however, as one would expect with a fully handmade and hand painted teacup there will be slight variations from cup to cup, such as imagery, text spacing, color and clarity. Embrace the uniqueness of each piece.

Each purchase is for one teacup.

Height: ~ 5.4 cm

Diameter : ~ 6.9 cm

Weight: ~ 65 g

[returning sweetness] Punchy fragrance, this blend can be brewed on the light side to accentuate it's subtlety or pushed for a full strength experience.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.description_html:
Another installment in the Green Hype saga. A significant amount of aged material in the blend to smooth out the experience. The new material in the blend is punchy and full bodied with an intense huigan [the lingering sweetness in the mouth after drinking a tea]. Excellent daily drinking raw Puer with plenty of intrigue and character to keep you engaged from cup to cup.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2025 Kong
products.description_html:
2025 Kong is a blend of high-end Yiwu. We wouldn't really recommend this tea to beginners or tea drinkers on a tight budget. We made it to age for ourselves as a treat this spring, but decided to sell a few cakes for those who want in on the experience.

Smooth, elegant and subtle. Enduring, sweet and energetic. A sparkling example of the beauty of Yiwu.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2025 Groove Wax
products.description_html:
An experimental blend of white teas from Fujian and  Yunnan provinces, spanning multiple years and varietals of material.

Our 2025 Groove Wax blend boasts the fragrances of Fujian, with whiffs of toasted coconut atop a sweet hay aroma from Yunnan. The body of the tea is thicker than you'd expect from a purely Fujian white tea, with more endurance to boot. The Fujian white teas in the blend are very young, but we look forward to how they'll smooth out and settle in with aging.

 

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2025 Echols
products.description_html:
Our 2025 Echols is a sun dried black tea blend made from Yunnan large leaf varietal that is typically destined to become raw Puer.

Herbaceous aromas, maybe you'll detect a note of catnip or something else in the mint family. Stout body and ever so slightly savory, not a typical sweet black tea affair. Recommend brewing this gongfu to extract maximum nuance, thought it's been a great big teapot companion for morning dimsum too.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: Daily Xiao Zhong
products.description_html:
A new contender in our lineup of outstanding daily drinkers.

Our Daily Xiao Zhong is a classic style black tea from Fujian province.

Uplifting aromatics, depth of flavor, and most of all no fuss. For lovers of traditional Fujian black teas who want to keep their tea budget in check and not worry about the morning pot. Drinks beautifully gongfu style, but also a great candidate for a big ol' teapot and a long steeping. If you add cream and honey in the morning to accompany your toast and jam you'll get no arguments from us.

Available in quantities of 50g and 250g.

products.name: 2025 Glider
products.description_html:
2025 Glider is a blend of high-end raw Puer teas from areas with less fame and underappreciated quality. This lack of fame helps keep the price in check, and the addition of aged raw Puer maocha from our vault helps to balance the freshness. Thick bodied sweetness, strong huigan (returning sweetness in the mouth) and stone fruit aromatics.  Our pick for an old arbor experience that won't break the bank.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2025 Chuan Zibai
products.description_html:
A tea that began as an experiment for our tea club years ago. We commissioned a Sichuan green tea farmer to use some of their purple varietal material to produce a white tea using Fujian style processing.

The results were a creamy, sweet and succulent white tea with bright aromatics and a stone fruit character that flooded our inbox with requests for more. After waiting another year for the weather to cooperate, we commissioned enough for a pressed production. Wonderful white tea and a unique standout; this combination of provenance and production style is far from common.


Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.name: 2025 Blood Moon
products.description_html:
The return of the Blood Moon. A bit of an odd hybrid Yunnan tea. Picked and processed most similarly to yueguangbai or moonlight white tea that has been shade dried, this tea was also intentionally partially oxidized, about half way to being a black tea*. It's a unique tea that feels closer to an aged shade dried white.

The bright and clear soup is sweet and enduring, with a velvety softness and aromas that flit between vegetal and fruity. Soft strawberry flavors and grassy honey are at the forefront of its youth, though we suspect it will deepen and thicken up in the coming years. It's a beautiful experiment to experience.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2025.

*For categorical boxes, Blood Moon doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

products.name: 2025 Dawuye Maocha Brick
products.description_html:
Or latest addition to our Dancong maocha brick lineup, the Dawuye varietal. Maocha is a bit of a misnomer, how can a tea be both maocha [loose tea] and a brick? In this case, the term maocha refers to the Dancong oolong tea being left in its raw form before pressing. We commissioned this production to be left with stems and large leaves for this pressing.

The brick is fruity sweet, with a balance of fresh green apple sweetness in the aroma and a darker stone fruit flavor profile. Layered scents dance between steeps, leaving a long trail behind them. 

Our Dancong oolong tea bricks are a little tricky to brew. Very punchy when pushed, we recommend dropping your leaf down a couple of grams and doing flash steeps gongfu style. The tea can often be heavily fragmented when broken off of the brick, which means the surface area is multiplied and the tea steeps fast and strong. For example, we usually brew 6 grams of raw Puer in a 100ml gaiwan, but for this tea we drop down to around 4 grams for a more even session.

Each brick is 200 grams. This is a 2024 Dancong, pressed in early 2025.

products.name: Decaf Raw Puer
products.description_html:
One of our new Decaf tea experiments. We commissioned this tea to be decaffeinated using the CO2 process to lower the caffeine to the EU standard. This does not mean that the tea is caffeine free, but it does mean that it only has around 0.4% of the original caffeine content. (Unless you are super sensitive to caffeine, it's barely noticeable) This process does change the overall flavor and aroma, but they're excellent for most people who need a night time drinking option. 

Have you ever wanted just one more session of raw Puer tea, but you also have to work in the morning? This is the scenario our Decaf raw Puer was built to address. The intensity of raw Puer tea, without the sleep wrecking power. This is it's own 2024 blend, but most similar to 2024 Everybody Works But Father. The processing changes the color of the tea, but it's still young raw Puer. 

The characteristic base of raw Puer is still present. Deep sweetness and long lingering huigan (returning sweetness in the mouth), along with a plesant bitterness and complex depth. Any degenerate tea lover would be happy to drink this at 1 in the morning. 

Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

products.name: 2025 Scrip
products.description_html:
This tea was made in late 2024 using a traditional technique for bamboo Puer pressing.

Scrip is a production of Huangpian [larger, older Puer leaves] that were hand roasted over charcoal in fragrant bamboo. This young tea is strong and fragmented, with a heavy punch of astringency and a thick sweet character. An intense cup of aroma and flavor for lovers of young tea or a tea that will become even more engaging with age.

Each full piece is roughly 200 grams of tea, with samples available.

products.name: 2025 Miss Bliss
products.description_html:
Miss Bliss is a new white tea blend made with traditional bamboo processing. 

A bright and fruity sun dried white tea from Yunnan province that was calmed and smoothed out by the flame of the charcoal roast. Miss Bliss is a soothing and heavy soup with a broad range of aromatics. As with most bamboo pressed tea, the tea is broken up during processing and has a lot of surface area, so a little bit of tea weight goes a long way in creating a strong cup.

Pressed and fired in late 2024, rested until 2025 spring for release.

Each piece of bamboo was pressed with 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2025 Jonia
products.description_html:
Old arbor sun dried white tea from Yunnan sent to Fujian province in 2024 to be hand charcoal roasted in the Wuyi mountains by veteran yancha oolong makers. The Jonia blend was rested until early 2025 when it was pressed.

Engaging fragrances abound, with a milk chocolate and marzipan sweetness. Sturdy and enduring with an incredible aromatic profile. We love our charcoal roasted white teas. They tiptoe into unknown spaces of tea aromatics and flavor and Jonia is a simply lovely example. 

Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.name: 2025 Alazani
products.description_html:
A blend of several small batch ripe Puer teas fermented using our own material and produced under our own supervision spanning several years, our Alazani blend was then sent to Fujian province to be charcoal roasted by hand by veteran Wuyi Yancha makers in 2024 and pressed in early 2025 in Yunnan after a period of rest.

Toasted cocoa nibs and forest floor, a light and balanced bitterness enhances the body throughout the session. There is a woodsy sweetness atop petrol, with the remnants of the charcoal roast creeping along the base. 

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2025 Pine Darts
products.description_html:
A blend of our white2tea Yunnan small batch shou Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

There are two kinds of tea drinkers in the world, those who want feet and cigarettes on their tea wrappers and those who don't. If you're still reading this description, then you can safely purchase this tea. Campfire coals and ash in a damp forest. Petrichor and the hefty body you need from a shou Puer.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2025 Laocong Lapsun
products.description_html:
Sun dried old arbor assamica varietal from Yunnan province that is typically made into raw Puer. We commissioned these black tea productions in 2024 and sent the blend to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

An answer to a question that nobody asked, "What if high quality old arbor Yunnan black tea materials were made into Lapsang." The result is what you'd expect; all of the heavy full bodied soup and full feeling of quality Yunnan material with aromatics that mirror the traditional Fujian smoke, all singing together in harmony. We blended four different old arbor black teas in 2024 to create this blend. The result is a truly special treat for black tea lovers and smoke aficionados alike.

Pressed in 2025. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2025 Auntie Stacks
products.description_html:
A blend of Yunnan raw Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

A natural fit for cigar lovers and Scotch whisky fanatics who want tea in the morning, but this tea is a surprise that will likely garner even fans who are wary of smoke as well.

Strong bitterness and full body with heavy feeling. Top quality huangpian elevated with the added dimension of the flame. Seared leather and tobacco notes underneath the smoke cloud. Burly intensity when pushed, with a dynamic character that will only improve with age.


Pressed in 2020. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

For aging, we recommend that smoked teas be sealed and separated from other teas, as the fresh smoke will pass along to the teas next to it. Or you can keep them with your cigars.

An array of fragrances and flavors, baked apples, scorched nutmeg and cinnamon poured over smooth stones. Worthy of focused attention from steep to steep to engage with the subtle changes this tea has to offer. 

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.description_html:
OBSX is an oolong tea from the Fujian province of China.

The long awaited return of a classic Wuyi Yancha (rock oolong) made from older bush material, this tea is often called laocong shuixian which literally translates as old bush narcissus; shuixian being the varietal of tea. Our old bush shuixian is a robust tea with deep aroma and character that evolves from steep to steep in a gongfu session.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: Gold Mercy
products.description_html:
Gold Mercy is an oolong tea from the Fujian province of China. Though we've come up with our fair share of over the top tea names in our day, Gold Mercy is actually taken from the varietal name Jinguanyin, which directly translate to the Golden Goddess of Mercy.

This yancha [rock tea] has a lighter oxidation and a softer roast. The fragrances are bright with a fruity apricot sweetness and a woody melody underneath. Osmanthus florals sit atop the light touch of roast, with a lingering minerality.

Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.
products.description_text: Gold Mercy is an oolong tea from the Fujian province of China. Though we've come up with our fair share of over the top tea names in our day, Gold Mercy is actually taken from the varietal name Jinguanyin , which directly translate to the Golden Goddess of Mercy. This yancha [rock tea] has a lighter oxidation and a softer roast. The fragrances are bright with a fruity apricot sweetness and a woody melody underneath. Osmanthus florals sit atop the light touch of roast, with a lingering minerality. Each purchase is for 25 grams of tea.

products.name: 2024 Baicha Fuzhuan
products.description_html:
A hybrid fu zhuan, or fu brick. A traditional style of post fermented tea from Hunan province in China that contains "golden flowers" (eurotium cristatum).

Another white2tea experiment; this white tea from Yunnan province was sent to Hunan to be pressed in traditional fu brick style.

Originally featured in our monthly tea club, this white tea from Yunnan was sun-dried and has bright aromatics with a floral, fruity character that meld with the fu brick processing for a unique experience. Melon rinds, dipped in funky mountain honey. Thick bodied and intriguing. A beautiful tea and a rare experience of cross provincial processing that is rarely seen among the broader tea market.

Each brick is ~450g of pressed tea. This tea can be drank now or is an ideal candidate for further aging. 

Disclaimer: We've heard that people suffering from gluten allergies may be sensitive to Fu zhuan / eurotium cristatum. Best to avoid this tea if you are sensitive or have Celiac disease.

products.name: 2024 Chapo Mid
products.description_html:
Liubao heicha, also known as dark tea, a post fermented tea from Guangxi province in China.

This laochapo was a commisioned production of the late autumn, early winter coarse leaf style popular in Liubao. This version was roasted and has a smokey edge from the flame that will age with a different character from our 2021 Chapo.

This tea can be brewed gongfu style with long steeps or even simmered to release the flavors from the older leaves and stems. A very rustic style of tea, some of the bricks may have naturally occurring jinhua (eurotium cristatum), as well as all manner of odd bits one can expect in a rural, lower grade heicha.

Not the typical mass produced and pile fermented dark liubao. Raw may be a misnomer, but calling it green doesn’t quite seem right either, and some folk have even suggested this tea qualify as a yellow tea or some hybrid unfermented heicha. In China people often call it nongjia or farmer style, though it is rarely sold on the open market due to small production sizes and lack of proper accreditation. You will find similarities in this tea that spans genres – green tea, yellow tea, heicha, raw Puer – there is a reason you can’t pin it down easily. 

Each brick is ~500g of tea, pressed in late 2024.

products.name: Loon Teacup V3
products.description_html:
This loon teacup was designed and commissioned by white2tea. Made with a technique called langhong (also sometimes "ox blood" or langyaohong) that was developed in the Qing dynasty. The deep red exterior color of the glaze is famous for being difficult to control and fire correctly in the kiln.


Each piece is Jingdezhen porcelain, handmade and hand painted for white2tea. The pictures accurately represent the overall design of the teacup, however, as one would expect with a fully handmade and hand painted teacup there will be slight variations from cup to cup, such as imagery, color and clarity. Embrace the uniqueness of each piece.

Teacup dimensions:

Volume: ~ 65ml

Height: ~ 4.5 cm

Diameter : ~ 7 cm

Weight: ~ 90 g

products.name: white2tea monthly tea club subscription
products.description_html:
Unique teas delivered to your door step every month. Every month we curate a special package for our members to enjoy and every month is a unique surprise. We have pressed small batch commissioned productions, roasted one-of-a-kind oolongs, and overseen productions from the fresh leaf to the finished product; all for the club. No other tea club offers a unique monthly experience quite like white2tea.   

Each purchase for one month is a recurring $29.99 with shipping included. You only need to purchase one month, the payment will be charged automatically on the same date of the following month and you can cancel anytime via the customer portal in your welcome email.

Please ensure that your address for your order is both correct and up to date. You can edit your address via your customer portal as well. Each payment is for the following month and will be shipped on the first of the month. (For example; a July 5th payment would be for the August tea club, which would ship on August 1st)

If you'd like more information about our club, please read the tea club FAQ section.

Please note that if an order contains other teas along with an order for the tea club that they will all be shipped together. This means that your order will need to wait until the next tea club is shipped. 

Each purchase below is for a one month subscription for the white2tea club. Each payment is for the following month and the final date to participate is the last day of the month, for example, September 30th is the last day to sign up for the October club. Please contact us directly if you'd like to receive any previous months and we can invoice them separately.

products.name: 2024 Green Hype
products.description_html:
The latest installment in the Green Hype saga. A significant amount of aged material in the blend to smooth out the experience. The new material in the blend is punchy and full bodied with an intense huigan [the lingering sweetness in the mouth after drinking a tea]. Excellent daily drinking raw Puer with plenty of intrigue and character to keep you engaged from cup to cup.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Demon Slayer
products.description_html:
Yet another new take on our high end huangpian blend from 2018 Demon Slayer.

Stab your personal demons in the face with our blend of high end huangpian [the large leaves of raw Puer production]. Thick, enduring tea with strong feeling and heavy complexity. A great opportunity to drink high end old arbor material within the confines of a reasonable budget. Age or drink now as your inner demon slayer desires.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Astro Kittens
products.description_html:
The 2024 Astro Kittens is for bitter lovers. Bitterness that is extremely heavy, yet integrated with a complexity that few bitter teas offer. Depth, heavy feeling and a slight internal smokiness that flits over the tide of an intensely bitter body. Heavy enough to crush the spirits of most aspiring young sheng drinkers. Will age beautifully in the long term, or drink now as your bitter heart desires.


Each cake is 200 grams.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Sunskate
products.description_html:
Sunskate is a black tea from Yunnan province.

Sunskate was oxidized very lightly, so much so that we could probably refer to it as a strange oolong instead of a black tea. The goal was to leave room for further aging and oxidation in the coming years, but it's a beautiful tea fresh as well. Made from material usually destined for raw Puer production, Sunskate has a syrupy thick body with bright aromas uncommon in a black tea.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Dark Peony
products.description_html:
Yet another oddball white2tea processing adventure. Our 2024 Dark Peony is a Yunnan tea produced at our behest with a sort of combination between Fujian white tea style processing with the addition of oxidation that mimics an aged white or black tea.

Dark Peony has a complex aromatic profile that lilts between the brighter tones of a fresh white tea and the deeper ripe stone fruits of a black tea. The soup's character is somewhere in between sharp and soft, with a playful little dancing between personalities that make it both engaging and difficult to pin down.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2024.

*For categorical boxes, Dark Peony doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

products.name: 2024 Blood Moon
products.description_html:
The return of the Blood Moon. A bit of an odd hybrid Yunnan tea. Picked and processed most similarly to yueguangbai or moonlight white tea that has been shade dried, this tea was also intentionally partially oxidized, about half way to being a black tea*. It's a unique tea that feels closer to an aged shade dried white.

The bright and clear soup is sweet and enduring, with a velvety softness and aromas that flit between vegetal and fruity. Soft strawberry flavors and grassy honey are at the forefront of its youth, though we suspect it will deepen and thicken up in the coming years. It's a beautiful experiment to experience.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2024.

*For categorical boxes, Blood Moon doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

Every spring we try to flex our blending skills by making at least one raw Puer tea blend that defies its price tag, spitting in the face of all of our expensive teas. This year that's the Philtre. Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Judy
products.description_html:
Our 2024 Judy is a sun dried Yunnan white tea made from camellia sinensis assamica (large leaf varietal) leaves from old trees, usually destined for raw Puer production.

A thick and complex white tea, with layered fragrances and sweetness throughout; poets grab your pens, there are more than a few outlandish descriptions lurking in the flavors of this tea. Engaging from start to finish during a gongfu session, with enough power to entice dedicated raw Puer lovers.


Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.name: 2024 Alienist
products.description_html:
Alienist is a blend of aged raw Puer maocha that we stored in Menghai under dry conditions before sending it to Fujian to be charcoal roasted by hand in 2023 and rested until pressing in 2024.

Bright and fruity aromatics hiding behind the flame of the roast, clean and succulent huigan (returning sweetness) in the mouth a touch of bite from the flame and the astringency of the tea. Incredible substitute for expensive oolongs as a daily drinker.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2024 Camphire
products.description_html:
A blend of shou Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

A shou Puer blend that already had a camphor aroma disposition before being thrust into full blown camp fire territory. Soft, smooth soup and a forest floor backbone enveloped in pine smoke. This will likely be a love or hate tea for a lot of people, but the people loved it probably added it to the cart before reading this far. If you're on the fence, try a taste. At the very least it will be a unique experience.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2024 Great Blue Heron
products.description_html:
A blend of our own aged Yunnan raw Puer maocha spanning the mid-2010's, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

A perfect fit for Scotch whisky lovers and cigar fans who want tea in the morning, but this tea is a surprise that will likely garner even fans who are wary of smoke as well. Smoked and meaty, with herbaceous tobacco aromas and a middle aged woody incense at the base.

Pressed in 2024. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

For aging, we recommend that smoked teas be sealed and separated from other teas, as the fresh smoke will pass along to the teas next to it. Or you can keep them with your cigars.

products.name: 2023 Sheddan
products.description_html:
A hand roasted bamboo raw Puer blend made from high-quality raw Puer material. The bamboo processing of this tea means that the leaves are broken up, so the tea will brew faster and stronger due to the increased surface area. Fired and pressed in late 2023, rested until 2024 spring before release.

Sticky mouthfeel, intense huigan, intense aromatics. If you're a fan of high octance brews with a penchant for higher quality raw Puer material, this will be a perfect fit. If you're new to raw Puer tea, brew this with a light hand. The tight compression and broken leaves can easily become overwhelming.


Each piece of bamboo was pressed with 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2024 Swayback
products.description_html:
The 2024 Swayback ripe Puer was processed using a traditional technique of bamboo processing where the tea is pressed into fresh fragrant bamboo and hand roasted over an open flame before being dried for long term storage.

A blend of several small batch shou Puer teas, married together by the flame of the charcoal and the steam juices of fresh fragrant bamboo. We feel this style of tea is underappreciated, and continue to commission it year after year (though it's been far too long since we made a high-end shou). The charcoal roast, the bright sweet bamboo aromatics and the deep molasses of the shou sing together in perfect harmony.

Each purchase for a 200g piece will come enclosed in a bamboo shell similar to the one pictured, sizes and thicknesses will vary as one would expect with a plant.

products.name: 2024 5th Wave
products.description_html:
A blend of several small batch ripe Puer teas fermented using our own material in Menghai, our 5th Wave blend was then sent to Fujian province to be charcoal roasted by hand by veteran Wuyi Yancha makers in late 2023 and pressed in early 2024 in Yunnan after a period of rest.

People often ask us, "What tea should I drink as a coffee drinker?", so we made an honest attempt at answering that questions by fiddling around with our small batch shou Puer blending capabilities and then making a hybrid roasted tea with the help of our friends in Fujian. The results may not be beans, but considering our leaf-bound limitations, I'd say we could almost pass this off as shitty diner coffee. Thick bodied, roasted, with a lingering bitterness; goes well grandpa style with bacon and eggs, side of toast.

Each cake is 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2024 Charing Cross
products.description_html:
The return of one of our favorite charcoal roasted hybrid teas.

Old arbor sun dried white tea from Yunnan, sent to Fujian province to be hand charcoal roasted in the Wuyi mountains by veteran yancha oolong makers.

Of all the newly released Wuyi roasted and smoked Yunnan teas, this is the one that caught the tea maker's attention more than any other. (and not only because roasting a loose Yunnan white tea like this is incredibly difficult and time consuming, due to it's nature of being brittle and not compact in loose form) They absolutely fell in love with the results of this tea.

The fragrances and aromas burst forth from the outset with fig jam sweetness and flame floral perfume. Unique and hypnotic, not to be missed.


Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.description_html:
A 7g sample of this tea was included in the March 2024 tea club.

Another warehouse find aged raw Puer brick is not for the faint of heart. Let's just get that out of the way; If you are afraid of bits of random debris, unsightly leaves, unverifiable information, and this tea is not for you.

If you those caveats have not scared you off, this is an excellent tea with a lot of age and an incredibly reasonable price for a brick boasting over 20 years of age. Sweet, smooth and easy to drink, this Lincang area material has aged into a very chuggable bargain brick and the storage is very clean.

Each brick is ~250g.

products.name: 2023 Yulan Maocha Brick
products.description_html:
A first time release, our new Yulan Maocha brick. Maocha is a bit of a misnomer, how can a tea be both maocha [loose tea] and a brick? In this case, the term maocha refers to the Dancong oolong tea being left in its raw form before pressing. We commissioned this production to be left with stems and large leaves for this pressing.

Juicy florals and fruity sweetness permeate from the rinse. The traditional magnolia aroma and style present throughout the session, leaving a lingering sugar cookie sweetness behind. Strong when pushed, some might prefer a lighter session with very little leaf. We look forward to this tea as it ages in the coming years.

Our Dancong oolong tea bricks are a little tricky to brew. Very punchy when pushed, we recommend dropping your leaf down a couple of grams and doing flash steeps gongfu style. The tea can often be heavily fragmented when broken off of the brick, which means the surface area is multiplied and the tea steeps fast and strong. For example, we usually brew 6 grams of raw Puer in a 100ml gaiwan, but for this tea we drop down to around 4 grams for a more even session.

Each brick is 200 grams. Each brick will be shipped in an individual paper wrapper, or two bricks (or multiples of two) will be shipped in a bamboo leaf (there are two bricks wrapped in a bamboo leaf per "tong"). Some of the outer wrappers have some slight yellowing from the bamboo leaf, it's nothing to worry about.
products.description_text: A first time release, our new Yulan Maocha brick. Maocha is a bit of a misnomer, how can a tea be both maocha [loose tea] and a brick? In this case, the term maocha refers to the Dancong oolong tea being left in its raw form before pressing. We commissioned this production to be left with stems and large leaves for this pressing. Juicy florals and fruity sweetness permeate from the rinse. The traditional magnolia aroma and style present throughout the session, leaving a lingering sugar cookie sweetness behind. products.name: 2023 Point of No Return
products.description_html:
I hate writing about teas like this. What’s there to say? That it’s rare? It’s rare. That it’s from a forest? It’s from a forest. That the trees are old? They’re old. All of those descriptors are bandied about so often they've lost all meaning.

Nothing gets to the core of why a tea like this is special or different other than the experience of it.

It’s soothing and sweet and has an intense feeling to it. If the budget fits, I’d recommend people who love raw Puer experience it. It’s probably not worth the cost of admission if you’re new to raw Puer or on a tight tea budget, wait until you’ve got years of experience under your belt before you try this tea.

Pressed in 2023. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2023 Chuan Zibai
products.description_html:
A tea that began as an experiment for our tea club years ago. We commissioned a Sichuan green tea farmer to use some of their purple varietal material to produce a white tea using Fujian style processing.

The results were a creamy, sweet and succulent white tea with bright aromatics and a stone fruit character that flooded our inbox with requests for more. After waiting another year for the weather to cooperate, we commissioned enough for a pressed production. Wonderful white tea and a unique standout; this combination of provenance and production style is far from common.


Each cake is 200 grams, with 5 cakes per bamboo tong.

products.name: Borderline Hong
products.description_html:
This Fujian “black” tea is on the edge of what can truly fit the fully oxidized definition, but it’s close. The tea maker has opted to coax out more aroma and keep it bright, teasing oxidation up to the border of hong cha, but never quite crossing into full black tea territory. The result is a highly aromatic and very enjoyable tea with a silky texture and complex flavor profile. If you don’t fall in love with this tea gongfu style, worst case scenario you can make decadent iced tea with it for a summer afternoon. Or maybe that’s the best case scenario.


Each purchase is for 25g of tea.

products.name: 2019 Gongmei Minis
products.description_html:
Our 2019 Gongmei* is a Fujian white tea, stored in Fujian until white2tea purchased it for pressing in 2023.

An excellent daily white tea with smooth and soothing character. Plenty of spicy aromatics and sweet fruity character, and even a heavy broth when pushed. An ideal way to start the day and a flexible tea that can be brewed in nearly any style and still shine through with intrigue.

Each mini is ~7 grams. Each ~49g stack contains 7 minis.

2019 white tea, pressed in 2023.

*This tea is actually Shoumei grade tea. Around this time there was a change in the legal naming in Fujian that only this varietal be called Gongmei, so we actually printed Shoumei on the wrapper, but forgot and named in Gongmei on the site. In either case, same tea, larger leaf grade Fujian white.

products.name: 2021 Wood Chips Laochatou
products.description_html:
Laochatou are a condensed nugget of tea that naturally fuses together during the shou Puer pile process. These are from a 2021 batch.

A woody style of shou Puer from a big old pile. Smooth soup, aromatic and thick when pushed. A great daily drinker for lovers of shou Puer with a forest-centric palate.

Available in 50g and 250g bags of loose laochatou.

A word of fair warning, normally shou Puer can be sorted out using machines to remove most unwanted bits like hair, stray threads and the like, but with chatou the tea is fused together. So, if you are faint of heart and scared of a few stray bits here and there, skip this tea and go for a pressed cake like Lumber Slut. If you're not afraid of some white spots and surprises, this is a rewarding pile of nuggets. No need to break them apart, just hit them with a boiling rinse and you're off to the races.

Classic creamy mouthfeel and sugarcane sweetness. A nice balance of buds that is a cut above lower grade pickings, but that strikes a balance between price and more bud heavy baimudan pickings. The skill of Fujian tea making on full display, a beautiful white tea for daily drinking.

products.name: 2023 Zero Sum
products.description_html:
A remake of our sold out 2020 Zero Sum blend.

Our original description said, "An experimental tea blend that I couldn't recreate if I tried." Well, due to popular demand, we tried. The confluence of several uncommon teas spinning together in a heady tornado. The fragrances and flavors are far out there. Notes of cream and aged tobacco with a very strong full bodied tea. Best enjoyed with gongfu tea and built to age further, though it's delicious right now.

Pressed in 2023. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2023 Karst
products.description_html:
A don't judge a book by its cover white tea from Yunnan.

Our 2023 Karst isn't likely to win any beauty contests with the bud fans, but it's better than pretty teas in a much higher price bracket. Floral honeysuckle, bright clover and sweet grass aromatics. With a lighter hand and lower temps, it's a bright and sweet easy drinker. With boiling water and an extra gram or two, it's an intense golden fruit experience. A great tea with a great price tag.


Pressed in 2023. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2023 Raw Spring Liubao
products.description_html:
Liubao heicha, also known as dark tea, a post fermented tea from Guangxi province in China.

This tea was made on commission for white2tea in early spring of 2023.

Not the typical mass produced and pile fermented dark liubao. Raw may be a misnomer, but calling it green doesn’t quite seem right either, and some folk have even suggested this tea qualify as a yellow tea or some hybrid unfermented heicha. In China people often call it nongjia or farmer style, though it is rarely sold on the open market due to small production sizes and lack of proper accreditation. You will find similarities in this tea that spans genres – green tea, yellow tea, heicha, raw Puer – there is a reason you can’t pin it down easily. 

Bright aromas and sweetness with a hefty huigan (returning sweetness) that is sticky and refreshing. Lovely to drink now or age as you desire.

Each sample purchase is for 25g of loose tea. Each basket contains ~250g of tea.

products.name: 2022 Kuboo
products.description_html:
A hand roasted bamboo raw Puer blend made from bitter, bud heavy material. The bamboo processing of this tea means that the leaves are broken up, so the tea will brew faster and stronger due to the increased surface area. Fired and pressed in 2022, rested until 2023 spring before release.

A really intense punch in the face type of raw Puer. Not for the faint of heart. If you fear bitter intensity, don't buy this tea. If you haven't stopped reading by now, you should probably try it.


Each piece of bamboo was pressed with 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2022 Tiltshift Bamboo
products.description_html:
Our famed Tiltshift blend in a bamboo roasted version. An extremely bud heavy picking of yueguangbai, which is a shade dried white tea from Yunnan province. The processing of the tea have broken it up significantly, which means this tea will steep out stronger and more quickly due to the increased surface area. This is a smooth drinking white tea with a supple body and sweet aftertaste. The aroma of fragrant bamboo and the roast have thoroughly pentetrated the tea, making for a delicious brew.

Pressed and fired in 2022, rested until 2023 spring for release.

Each piece of bamboo was pressed with 200 grams of tea.

products.name: 2023 Yesheng Gushu Baicha
products.description_html:
Yesheng Gushu Baicha, literally translated as "wild ancient tree white tea", this tea comes from a wild varietal of tea leaf.

One of the most requested productions we have ever featured in any tea club, we were strong armed into producing this tea as a regular option.

A unique profile of bright wild vegetal flavors that drift between fresh cut cucumbers and a field of flowers in full bloom, simultaneously bitter and sweet. Whether or not those descriptions will fit your experience or not is anybody's guess. It is wildly difficult to pin this tea down and place into a box. Experience it for yourself.


Each cake is 200g. Cakes are packaged in tongs of five cakes.

Each cake is 200g. Cakes are packaged in tongs of five cakes.

products.name: 2023 Blood Moon
products.description_html:
The return of our sold out Blood Moon. A bit of an odd hybrid Yunnan tea. Picked and processed most similarly to yueguangbai or moonlight white tea that has been shade dried, this tea was also intentionally partially oxidized, about half way to being a black tea*. It's a unique tea that feels closer to an aged shade dried white.

The bright and clear soup is sweet and enduring, with a velvety softness and aromas that flit between vegetal and fruity. Soft strawberry flavors and grassy honey are at the forefront of its youth, though we suspect it will deepen and thicken up in the coming years. It's a beautiful experiment to experience.

Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong. Pressed in 2023.

*For categorical boxes, Blood Moon doesn't quite fit into either the white or black tea box, and technically is probably an oolong, due to it's partial oxidation during processing. However, for ease of understanding of this tea, since it drinks more like a black tea/white tea hybrid, we have listed it across those two categories rather than as an oolong tea, which in practice, it does not really resemble at all.

products.name: Hedgehog Teacup
products.description_html:
This hedgehog teacup was designed and commissioned by white2tea. Made with a technique called langhong (also sometimes "ox blood" or langyaohong) that was developed in the Qing dynasty. The deep red exterior color of the glaze is famous for being difficult to control and fire correctly in the kiln.


Each piece is Jingdezhen porcelain, handmade and hand painted for white2tea. Embrace the uniqueness of each piece.

Teacup dimensions:

Volume: ~ 65ml

Height: ~ 4.5 cm

Diameter : ~ 7 cm

Weight: ~ 90 g

products.name: 2023 Lapsun
products.description_html:
Sun dried bud heavy picking of assamica varietal from Yunnan province that is typically made into Puer. We commissioned this black tea production in 2022 and sent it to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse. Pressed in Yunnan in 2023.

All of the thick body and malty sweetness of a chocolatey Yunnan black tea, laced with the thick pine smoke of a Lapsang. Better than drinking scotch at 9 in the morning.


Pressed in 2022. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2023 Swerve
products.description_html:
Sun dried old arbor assamica varietal from Yunnan province that is typically made into raw Puer tea. We commissioned this production in 2022, sent it to Wuyi in Fujian to be hand charcoal roasted by veteran yancha makers. Pressed in Yunnan in early 2023.

Our 2023 Swerve is vibrantly aromatic and syrupy sweet. Spiced plums, toasted cinnamon and mulled wine tannins. Enough intrigue to entrance veteran oolong and black tea drinkers, coupled with heroic endurance. Spectacular tea.

Pressed in 2022. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are in bamboo tongs, with five cakes per tong.

products.name: 2023 Firebat
products.description_html:
A blend of Yunnan raw Puer, sent to a smokehouse in Tongmuguan village in Fujian to be pine smoked by a veteran Lapsang smoker. The three day smoking process occurs at temperatures from 100C to 120C in an old style Lapsang smokehouse.

A natural fit for cigar lovers and Scotch whisky fanatics who want tea in the morning, but this tea is a surprise that will likely garner even fans who are wary of smoke as well.

Smoked citrus and tobacco aromas with a punch of raw Puer with a returning huigan (lasting sweetness in the mouth). 

Pressed in 2020. Each cake is 200g. The cakes are wrapped in bamboo leaf tongs, with five cakes per tong.

For aging, we recommend that smoked teas be sealed and separated from other teas, as the fresh smoke will pass along to the teas next to it. Or you can keep them with your cigars.
